title: StockSmart Sourcing Desk Note — Supply Allowance Days for Special and Non-Stock Items in Consigned Bins
content:
**Rule.** For the reorder point of a new consigned StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines, the supply of the transferred item adds allowance days: an item that any VendPoint selection-setting entry of the customer flags as a special item adds 4 days; an item never so flagged that the program's ship-to has booked as a non-stock special order adds 2 days; any other item adds none.

**Records read.** The customer's selection-setting entries under the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, any of which may carry the special item flag for the item; and the order lines of the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account, for bookings of the item as a non-stock special order. Neither record is limited to a window.

| Flagged special on any VendPoint selection-setting entry | Booked at the ship-to as a non-stock special order | Allowance days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | 4 days |
| no | yes | 2 days |
| no | no | none |

The special item flag decides first: an item so flagged adds 4 days whether or not it was ever booked as a non-stock special order.
